rationale: Minister of Natural Resources mentioned several measures available to the oil and gas industry but did not provide a clear plan or timeline for a specific aid package.
conditions: The government continues to step forward in its response to the impacts of COVID-19 on the provinces of Newfoundland and Labrador, Alberta, and Saskatchewan.
dissent: Mr. Blake Richards expressed dissatisfaction with the lack of a specific plan and the minister's response.

records.decision: The federal government will provide support to the tourism sector through various measures, including the CEBA account, wage subsidy, rent relief, and funding through regional development agencies.
rationale: The federal government has taken several steps in recent weeks that will meaningfully support workers and communities that depend on this industry.
conditions: Details about the support through regional development agencies will be coming soon.
dissent: Mr. Blake Richards stated that the tourism minister hasn't been listening and hasn't addressed many of the concerns about seasonal industries and the hard economic recovery after the pandemic.

evidence.quote: They will be having access also to funding through the regional development agencies, and we'll be coming up with the details soon.

records.decision: The federal government will provide support to the oil and gas industry through the Canada emergency wage subsidy, new loans from the Business Development Bank of Canada, and working with provincial partners and businesses of all sizes.
rationale: We have been working with our provincial partners. We have been working with businesses of all sizes in the oil and gas industry. We have been working with labour, concentrating on workers and concentrating on the companies that support those jobs to make sure that they remain whole and those jobs will be there for those workers.
conditions: Details about the support through the Business Development Bank of Canada are not specified.
dissent: Mr. Blake Richards stated that the support measures won't actually help the industry to recover and that the government should expedite the approval of private sector projects.
